item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel during operation to capture him
item.description: The Mexican army killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, Nemesio Rubén Oseguera Cervantes, “El Mencho, ” on Sunday, decapitating what had become Mexico's most powerful cartel and giving the government its biggest prize yet to show the Trump administration its efforts.

item.title: Lawmakers say church tax deduction bill would align Ohio with federal law
item.description: Ohio lawmakers defended a proposal this month to allow state income tax deductions for church donations, arguing the change would align state policy with federal law and bolster faith-based services in local communities.

item.title: Grassroots effort to eliminate Ohio property tax drawing mixed reaction
item.description: There’s a volunteer-driven effort to abolish property taxes in Ohio. The group is petitioning now, with the goal of getting a constitutional amendment on the ballot. The movement has been met with support and backlash.

item.title: Thunder hit 21 3s to beat Cavs 121-113, snapping Cleveland’s 7-game streak
item.description: Isaiah Joe scored 22 points and Cason Wallace added 20 points and 10 assists to help the short-handed Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 121-113 on Sunday.

item.title: Wanted man arrested after leading police on 120 mph chase
item.description: A man with an active warrant out of Boardman Township led police on a multi-county chase that exceeded speeds of 120 miles per hour.

item.title: WATCH: Large ice shove along Lake Erie shoreline
item.description: An apparent ice shove created tall mountains of thick ice along the Lake Erie shoreline this weekend.

item.title: Blizzard warnings cascade across East Coast as winter storm hits
item.description: New York City and New Jersey announced travel bans, airlines canceled thousands of flights and even Broadway shows were canceled Sunday evening as a fierce winter storm bore down on the Northeastern U.S., prompting blizzard warnings from Maryland to Massachusetts.

item.title: ODOT treating roads to get ahead of messy morning commute
item.description: The snow is making a return to Northeast Ohio after a brief stretch of warmer weather.
